ReviewM.masked_source_shell_product_limit.{u_1, u_2, u_3, u_4} {X : Type u_1} {J : Type u_2} {R : Type u_3}
  {E : Type u_4} [MeasurableSpace X] (mu : Measure X) (p : E → X → ℝ) (hp : ReviewM.PositivePartition p) (d : J → X → ℂ)
  (e : X → ℂ) (hd : ∀ (j : J), Integrable (d j) mu) (he : Integrable e mu) (omega : R → X → ℂ) (S : Filter J)
  (L : Filter R) (hm : ∀ᶠ (r : R) in L, AEStronglyMeasurable (omega r) mu)
  (hb : ∀ᶠ (r : R) in L, ∀ᵐ (x : X) ∂mu, ‖omega r x‖ ≤ 1) (hs : Tendsto (fun j => ∫ (x : X), ‖d j x - e x‖ ∂mu) S (𝓝 0))
  (hl : Tendsto (fun r => ∫ (x : X), ‖omega r x * e x - e x‖ ∂mu) L (𝓝 0)) :
  Tendsto (fun jr => ∑' (i : E), ‖∫ (x : X), ↑(p i x) * (omega jr.2 x * d jr.1 x) ∂mu - ∫ (x : X), ↑(p i x) * e x ∂mu‖)
    (S ×ˢ L) (𝓝 0)
'ReviewM.masked_source_shell_product_limit' depends on axioms: [propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound]
ReviewM.actual_source_diagonal_L1_limit.{u_1, u_2} {X : Type u_1} {V : Type u_2} [MeasurableSpace X] [AddCommGroup V]
  [Module ℂ V] (nu : Measure X) (b : X → ℝ) (hb : ∀ (x : X), 0 < b x) (vol : ℝ) (hvol : 0 < vol) (e0 eF : V →ₗ[ℂ] ℂ)
  (Theta : ↥(OSourceClosure.twoMomentSource e0 eF) →ₗ[ℂ] ↥(Lp ℂ 2 nu)) (u v : ℕ → ↥(Lp ℂ 2 nu))
  (hc : Summable fun i => ‖u i‖ * ‖v i‖) :
  Tendsto
    (fun T =>
      ∫ (x : X),
        ‖∑' (i : ℕ),
              HNormalizedKernel.haarKernel b vol
                (↑↑((Q.IntegratedSourceCutoff.finiteSourceSpan e0 eF Theta T).starProjection (v i))) (↑↑(u i)) x x -
            ∑' (i : ℕ),
              HNormalizedKernel.haarKernel b vol (↑↑((OSourceClosure.sourceClosure e0 eF Theta).starProjection (v i)))
                (↑↑(u i)) x x‖ ∂ENNReal.ofReal vol • nu)
    atTop (𝓝 0)
'ReviewM.actual_source_diagonal_L1_limit' depends on axioms: [propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound]
